name: pi-desktop
description: Pi Desktop — Electron + Vue3 Agent Workspace
author: ImYoyoData

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-highlightjs-exports.mjs && node scripts/build-lan-web.mjs && electron-vite build
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run dugite:git && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run dist:win:x64 && npm run dist:win:arm64
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs arm64 && electron-builder --win --arm64 -c.npmRebuild=true
scripts.dist:win:fast: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false -c.compression=store
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:arm64 && npm run dist:mac:x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -c.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs x64 && npx --yes @electron/rebuild --force --only=node-pty --arch=x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 -c.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist:dir: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run dugite:git && electron-builder --dir
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/ensure-dugite-git.mjs && node scripts/patch-highlightjs-exports.mjs && electron-builder install-app-deps
